definitions.explanation: Equipment worn to protect the body from injury, used in sports like kendo, baseball, and other activities.
Armor or protective equipment used historically in battle or in fantasy/game contexts.

notes:
Most commonly associated with kendo gear in modern Japanese. The full set of kendo {防具|ぼうぐ} consists of ⟦{面|めん}→面：09933_men⟧ (face guard), {胴|どう} (torso protector), ⟦{小手|こて}→小手：28868_kote⟧ (gauntlets), and {垂|たれ} (waist protector).
